about: Ski routes OpenStreetMap still has but that are gone on the ground. scripts/build-winter.mjs leaves these out of data/ski.json on every rebuild (by OpenStreetMap id, or by name inside the box when an id is missing), so they don't come back with the next data run. Hand-kept: add one entry with who said it and when.
